title: TesseraQL view document v1
description: Schema for TesseraQL declarative view documents (*.view.yml): what a route renders through the framework's tql/view/* patterns instead of a hand-written template. Documented in declarative-views.md.
$comment: A view document is strict: the loader refuses an unknown key at every nesting level (TQL-VIEW-3314), so this schema declares additionalProperties false to match.

recipe.description: Which view this document is: list | form | detail | dashboard. A form derives its fields from the action: route's input: block; a dashboard composes panels:.

title.description: The heading this view renders. A message key resolves through the app bundles; anything else renders literally.

template.description: The pattern override this view renders through instead of its bundled `tql/view/*` pattern (customization ladder L2). Resolved beside the view document, then under the app template root. Documented in declarative-views.md.

action.description: The id of the command route a form view submits to; its `input:` block is where the form's fields come from.

source.description: The model key a view reads its rows from - a name in the route's `sources:`, whatever arm it declares, defaulting to `main`.

search.description: The route input a list view binds its search box to; it must be declared on the route.

fields.description: The fields a form or detail view renders, in order. Documented in declarative-views.md.

columns.description: The columns a list view renders, in order. Documented in declarative-views.md.

children.description: Views embedded inside this one, keyed by the slot each fills. Documented in declarative-views.md.

panels.description: The panels a dashboard view composes, in order. Documented in declarative-views.md.

slots.description: Named regions this view exposes for a composing parent to fill. Documented in declarative-views.md.

refreshOn.description: Refetch this view's refresh region whenever a command emits this topic (docs/realtime.md). List, detail and dashboard views only - not forms.
